caption: The drawing features a sleeveless double-breasted vest displayed prominently in the center, rendered in light beige with blue outlines accentuating the seams and pockets. The vest has six buttons on the front, two horizontal pockets with blue piping, and a wide, shawl collar made of pink and white diagonally striped fabric. Above and to the right of the vest, there is a square swatch illustrating the shawl collar's fabric, which displays alternating diagonal pink stripes and a fan-like white pattern. Below the central vest, two smaller sketches in pencil show the vest’s front and back views without color: the left sketch depicts the vest with defined seams and button placements, while the right sketch highlights the back with collar structure and rear panel lines. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Vest
